comments.body: Honestly I doubt 26 from BEMACS will cut for Eth and EPFL alike. All the Bocconi people I know who are doing these programs had 29+ atleast (know someone with 29 getting rejected from both). Both these unis place a lot of weightage on GPA. I think it might be worth exploring other options. GRE makes a difference for borderline cases, but I am pretty sure even a perfect score will not give you a decent enough chance.
comments.author: Internal-Bet3910
